entries.title: Narrator: "I had signed an official document c..."
entries.dialogueText: I had signed an official document ceding ownership of the Aureus gas field to the Grand Duchy of Pales. According to reports, LesPower would shortly purchase the exploration rights to the field.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Alliance of Nations had accepte..."
entries.dialogueText: The Alliance of Nations had accepted our request to arbitrate ownership of the Aureus gas field. Preliminary hearings were to begin soon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the meantime, Lespian prime mini..."
entries.dialogueText: In the meantime, Lespian prime minister Patricio Alvarez had contacted Laurento, asking to speak with me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was spending the week at my palac..."
entries.dialogueText: I was spending the week at my palace in Monqiz. Laurento visited to brief me ahead of the phone call.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stepped in front of my desk and..."
entries.dialogueText: He stepped in front of my desk and bowed.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Good afternoon, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust you're well, Mr. Esquibel?""
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you're well, Mr. Esquibel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No time for small talk. Prime Mini..."
entries.dialogueText: "No time for small talk. Prime Minister Alvarez will be calling soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't know if it's a good aftern..."
entries.dialogueText: "I won't know if it's a good afternoon or not until I've found out what Lespia wants from me."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Well enough. Though I must say I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well enough. Though I must say I'm worried by the increasing tensions in Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll do my best to defuse tensions..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do my best to defuse tensions. Just call me Romus the Defuser."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Very well. What did you want to kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. What did you want to know about him?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Right you are. Forgive the inappro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right you are. Forgive the inappropriate greeting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand that President Smolak..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that President Smolak may have lingering security concerns after the bombing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Isn't there anything we can do? Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Isn't there anything we can do? President Smolak can't keep holding on to Zille forever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled wryly."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled wryly.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It's not entirely up to you. I hop..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not entirely up to you. I hope the upcoming Alliance of Nations session on South Merkopa will provide us with some clarity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smoothed one of the ends of his..."
entries.dialogueText: He smoothed one of the ends of his moustache.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I have filed a complaint with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have filed a complaint with the Alliance of Nations. Presumably this will be addressed during the upcoming South Merkopa session."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""For now, though, we have Prime Min..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now, though, we have Prime Minister Alvarez to worry about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why do you think he's calling?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why do you think he's calling?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did my father ever talk to him?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did my father ever talk to him?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How trustworthy is he?""
entries.dialogueText: "How trustworthy is he?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard he's an alcoholic.""
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard he's an alcoholic."
